coverage_limits: The root system is A1, the original design's selected-root-system branch. No claim is made for arbitrary root systems.
Polynomial-representation faithfulness is proved for q not a root of unity and t nonzero; Macdonald eigenvalue separation additionally excludes t^2=q^-N for every positive integer N.
The standard Macdonald inner-product norm formula and the general-root-system Macdonald theorem are not claimed.
A specific skein algebra map, knot parameter map, and model-specific physical operator theorem remain separate interface obligations.
